You can imagine a man writing "I'm a (very broke) drag queen."

The reason they wouldn't write "I'm a (very broke) transvestite" but would write "I'm a (very broke) trans woman" is the same reason that someone wouldn't write "This was where I got the furniture for my BDSM dungeon" but would write "This was where I got the furniture for my bedroom" even though it is common knowledge that bedrooms are used for sex. You hide things that are exclusively sexual.

Why mention being trans at all?

To make donors who read it feel good about having helped a marginalized person. ;)
